name: Paneer Ghee Roast
steps: Whisk yogurt with 3 g salt and coat paneer cubes. Set aside for 15 minutes while preparing the roast masala.
Dry-roast chilies, coriander, cumin, fennel, pepper and fenugreek on low heat for 3–4 minutes until fragrant, without burning. Cool, then blend with tamarind and 100 ml water into a thick paste.
Heat half the ghee in a wide pan. Sear marinated paneer on two sides for about 2 minutes total and remove; keep the heat moderate so the yogurt does not scorch.
Add remaining ghee, curry leaves and spice paste. Stir frequently for 8–10 minutes until the paste deepens to brick-red and ghee appears at the edges; add jaggery and remaining salt.
Fold paneer into the thick masala and cook 2–3 minutes until every cube is coated. Serve warm with neer dosa or rice; this roast should be thick, not soupy.
tips: Mild Kashmiri chilies give the traditional deep red color without relying on food dye.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
